rows.original: You'll do it because it must be done. You'll do it because nobody else can. And if you don't, millions will die.

rows: 我的建议是：说实话。这些人在黑暗里干活，什么都看得见。

rows.original: My advice, tell the truth. These men work in the dark; they see everything.

rows: 可第二天早上醒来，你还是你。然后你才明白：那一直都是你，只是你自己不知道。

rows.original: But then you wake up the next morning and you're still you. And you realize: that was you all along. You just didn't know.

rows: 我们说的每一个谎，都欠真相一笔债。这笔债迟早要还。

rows.original: Every lie we tell incurs a debt to the truth. Sooner or later, that debt is paid.

rows: 我是个无足轻重的人，瓦列拉。我一向如此。我曾希望有一天自己能有点分量，可我没有。我只是站在那些有分量的人旁边。

rows.original: I'm an inconsequential man, Valera. That's all I've ever been. I hoped that one day I would matter, but I didn't. I just stood next to people who did.

rows: 没人会想到这种事会落到自己头上。

rows.original: No one ever thinks it's going to happen to them.

rows: 生命因何而沉睡？因为我们尚未准备好迎接死亡。
我任命运拨转轮盘，孤注一掷，遍历死地而后生。一切献给——琥珀王！
于时光的尽头，我们终将重逢。
只要不失去你的崇高，整个世界都会向你敞开。
旅程总有一天会迎来终点，不必匆忙。
欲买桂花同载酒…只可惜故人，何日再见呢？
浮世景色百千年依旧，人之在世却如白露与泡影。
想来是人间万般磨难，她也享着一份。
可见战争不只是政治行为，也是真正的政治工具，是政治交往的延续，以另一种手段完成同一件事。

rows.original: We see, therefore, that War is not merely a political act, but also a real political instrument, a continuation of political commerce, a carrying out of the same by other means.

rows: 战争中的一切都很简单，但最简单的事也难。

rows.original: Everything is very simple in War, but the simplest thing is difficult.

rows: 理论一旦触及精神力量的领域，就变得无比困难。

rows.original: Every theory becomes infinitely more difficult from the moment that it touches on the province of moral quantities.

rows: 战争比世上任何事都更甚：结局总与预期不同，近看又和远望时两样。

rows.original: In War more than anywhere else in the world things happen differently to what we had expected, and look differently when near, to what they did at a distance.

rows: 倘若勇敢在战争中都不配有一席之地，它在人类的哪一行当里还配呢？

rows.original: In fact, in what branch of human activity should boldness have a right of citizenship if not in War?

rows: 每次交战都是对物质与精神力量的流血较量；结束时两者剩余最多的一方即是胜者。

rows.original: Every combat is therefore the bloody and destructive measuring of the strength of forces, physical and moral; whoever at the close has the greatest amount of both left is the conqueror.

rows: 胜利的魔力与失败的诅咒，就这样改变了同样要素的分量。

rows.original: Such is the alteration which the magic of victory and the curse of defeat produces in the specific weight of the same elements.

rows: 兵力越弱，目标越须克制；兵力越弱，能支撑的时间也越短。

rows.original: The weaker the force the more moderate must be the object it proposes to itself, and the weaker the force the shorter time it will last.

rows: 战争其实更多是为防御者而发生的：入侵只唤起抵抗，有了抵抗，才有战争。

rows.original: War actually takes place more for the defensive than for the conqueror, for invasion only calls forth resistance, and it is not until there is resistance that there is war.

rows: 进攻的优势虽逐日消减，只要能维持到缔结和约，目标便算达成。

rows.original: If a preponderance on the side of the attack, although thus daily diminishing, is still maintained until peace is concluded, the object is attained.

rows: 由此看来，战争是一个不可分割的整体，局部战果只有相对于整体才有价值。

rows.original: In this view, therefore, war is an indivisible whole, the parts of which (the subordinate results) have no value except in their relation to this whole.

rows: 我们加于敌人的压力，取决于双方政治要求的比例。

rows.original: The compulsion which we must use towards our enemy will be regulated by the proportions of our own and his political demands.

rows: 雅典势力的增长，以及由此在拉栖代梦引起的惊惧，使战争不可避免。

rows.original: The growth of the power of Athens, and the alarm which this inspired in Lacedaemon, made war inevitable.

rows: 我们总是假定敌人的谋划周全来备战；希望不该寄托于他的失误，而应寄托于自己的准备。

rows.original: In practice we always base our preparations against an enemy on the assumption that his plans are good; indeed, it is right to rest our hopes not on a belief in his blunders, but on the soundness of our provisions.

rows: 说得直白些，你们握着的是一份僭政；取得它也许是错的，放手却危险。

rows.original: For what you hold is, to speak somewhat plainly, a tyranny; to take it perhaps was wrong, but to let it go is unsafe.

rows: 它的治理偏向多数人而非少数人，因此被称为民主。

rows.original: Its administration favours the many instead of the few; this is why it is called a democracy.

rows: 以他们为榜样，认定幸福是自由的果实、自由是勇敢的果实，就永不回避战争的危险。

rows.original: These take as your model and, judging happiness to be the fruit of freedom and freedom of valour, never decline the dangers of war.

rows: 词语不得不改变寻常的含义，去承担当时赋予它的意思。

rows.original: Words had to change their ordinary meaning and to take that which was now given them.

rows: 战争剥夺了日常所需的从容供给，成了粗暴的主宰，把多数人的品性磨得与他们的时运相称。

rows.original: war takes away the easy supply of daily wants, and so proves a rough master, that brings most men’s characters to a level with their fortunes.

rows: 你们城邦今日的兴盛与近来的增益，不应使你们以为命运永远站在你们这边。

rows.original: Accordingly, the prosperity which your city now enjoys, and the accession that it has lately received, must not make you fancy that fortune will be always with you.

rows: 强者尽其所能，弱者受其所必受。

rows.original: the strong do what they can and the weak suffer what they must.

rows: 关于神，我们相信；关于人，我们知道：依其本性的必然，凡能统治之处便去统治。

rows.original: Of the gods we believe, and of men we know, that by a necessary law of their nature they rule wherever they can.

rows: 任何远征初起时都最可怖；若它迟迟不现身，人的勇气便复苏，最后几乎漠然地看着它到来。

rows.original: Every armament was most terrible at first; if it allowed time to run on without showing itself, men’s courage revived, and they saw it appear at last almost with indifference.

rows: 我们仍可希望苦难会减轻：敌人已交足好运；若有神明因这次远征见罪，我们也已受够惩罚。

rows.original: Indeed we may hope that they will be lightened: our enemies have had good fortune enough; and if any of the gods was offended at our expedition, we have been already amply punished.

rows: 抛出诱饵引敌上钩；佯装混乱，然后击溃他。

rows.original: Hold out baits to entice the enemy. Feign disorder, and crush him.

rows: 作战以胜利为要旨，不在旷日持久的用兵。

rows.original: In war, then, let your great object be victory, not lengthy campaigns.

rows: 所以说：知彼知己，百战不殆。

rows.original: Hence the saying: If you know the enemy and know yourself, you need not fear the result of a hundred battles.

rows: 古人所谓善战者，不只取胜，更在胜得轻易。

rows.original: What the ancients called a clever fighter is one who not only wins, but excels in winning with ease.

rows: 力量可比张满的弓弩，决断则如扣动扳机。

rows.original: Energy may be likened to the bending of a crossbow; decision, to the releasing of the trigger.

rows: 善战者把意志强加于敌人，而不让敌人的意志强加于自己。

rows.original: Therefore the clever combatant imposes his will on the enemy, but does not allow the enemy’s will to be imposed on him.

rows: 包围敌军，要留一个缺口；不要把走投无路的敌人逼得太紧。

rows.original: When you surround an army, leave an outlet free. Do not press a desperate foe too hard.

rows: 把士卒置于无路可退之地，他们宁死也不逃。

rows.original: Throw your soldiers into positions whence there is no escape, and they will prefer death to flight.

rows: 就我个人而言，我曾激烈反对此举；至今仍认为由此而起的战争，是强国对弱国发动的最不义之战。

rows.original: For myself, I was bitterly opposed to the measure, and to this day regard the war, which resulted, as one of the most unjust ever waged by a stronger against a weaker nation.

rows: 国家如同个人，会因自己的罪过而受罚。

rows.original: Nations, like individuals, are punished for their transgressions.

rows: 经验证明，阻挠本国进行战争的人，无论对错，在生前与史册里都占不到令人羡慕的位置。

rows.original: Experience proves that the man who obstructs a war in which his nation is engaged, no matter whether right or wrong, occupies no enviable place in life or history.

rows: 这场战争对南北双方都代价高昂，耗去鲜血与财富，但这一切代价都值得。

rows.original: The war was expensive to the South as well as to the North, both in blood and treasure, but it was worth all it cost.

rows: 叛乱期间，我无时不在想，也常常说出：南方从自己的失败中所得，多于北方。

rows.original: There was no time during the rebellion when I did not think, and often say, that the South was more to be benefited by its defeat than the North.

rows: 决定战局命运的，常常是偶然。

rows.original: But accident often decides the fate of battle.

rows: 我一直后悔冷港那最后一次强攻。

rows.original: I have always regretted that the last assault at Cold Harbor was ever made.

rows: 邦联士兵如今是我们的俘虏，我们不愿在他们的覆亡上得意。

rows.original: The Confederates were now our prisoners, and we did not want to exult over their downfall.

rows: 凭阑久，疏烟淡日，寂寞下芜城。
半黄梅子，向晚一帘疏雨。
厌厌睡起，犹有花梢日在。
数点雨声风约住。朦胧淡月云来去。
绿杨庭院，暖风帘幕，有个人憔悴。
伤春不在高楼上，在灯前攲枕，雨外熏炉。
连呼酒，上琴台去，秋与云平。
隔江人在雨声中，晚风菰叶生秋怨。
恨芳菲世界，游人未赏，都付与、莺和燕。
幽梦觉，涓涓清露，一枝灯影里。
看画船，尽入西泠，闲却半湖春色。
欲黄昏。雨打梨花深闭门。
嫣然摇动，冷香飞上诗句。
出其东门，有女如云。虽则如云。匪我思存。
十亩之间兮，桑者闲闲兮，行与子还兮。
夏之日，冬之夜。百岁之后，归于其居。
迨天之未阴雨，彻彼桑土，绸缪牖户。
冷艳全欺雪，余香乍入衣。
送君还旧府，明月满前川。
寸心言不尽，前路日将斜。
只疑云雾窟，犹有六朝僧。
朝来入庭树，孤客最先闻。
山空松子落，幽人应未眠。
山中无历日，寒尽不知年。
秋风不相待，先至洛阳城。
遥怜故园菊，应傍战场开。
明月悬高树，长河没晓天。
悬灯千嶂夕，卷幔五湖秋。
山从人面起，云傍马头生。
人烟寒橘柚，秋色老梧桐。
寥寥人境外，闲坐听春禽。
海色晴看雨，江声夜听潮。
惟将终夜常开眼，报答平生未展眉。
漠漠水田飞白鹭，阴阴夏木啭黄鹂。
声喧乱石中，色静深松里。
三山半落青天外，二水中分白鹭洲。
永夜角声悲自语，中天月色好谁看。
五更鼓角声悲壮，三峡星河影动摇。
千秋万岁名，寂寞身后事。
来往不逢人，长歌楚天碧。
人世几回伤往事，山形依旧枕寒流。
红楼隔雨相望冷，珠箔飘灯独自归。
于今腐草无萤火，终古垂杨有暮鸦。
云边雁断胡天月，陇上羊归塞草烟。

rows.original: Man is born free; and everywhere he is in chains. One thinks himself the master of others, and still remains a greater slave than they.

rows: 最强者也从不足够强到永远做主人，除非他把力量变成权利，把服从变成义务。

rows.original: The strongest is never strong enough to be always the master, unless he transforms strength into right, and obedience into duty.

rows: 每个人把自己献给所有人，便没有献给任何人。

rows.original: each man, in giving himself to all, gives himself to nobody

rows: 谁拒绝服从公意，全体便要迫使他服从；这不过是说，他将被迫自由。

rows.original: whoever refuses to obey the general will shall be compelled to do so by the whole body. This means nothing less than that he will be forced to be free

rows: 仅凭欲望冲动行事是奴役，服从我们自己订立的法则才是自由。

rows.original: the mere impulse of appetite is slavery, while obedience to a law which we prescribe to ourselves is liberty.

rows: 公意总是正当的，并趋向公共利益；但人民的审议并不因此总是同样正确。

rows.original: the general will is always right and tends to the public advantage; but it does not follow that the deliberations of the people are always equally correct.

rows: 公意若要真正成为公意，其对象与本质都必须是普遍的：它既须出自全体，也须施于全体。

rows.original: the general will, to be really such, must be general in its object as well as its essence; that it must both come from all and apply to all

rows: 若问全体最大的善——一切立法体系都应以此为归宿——究竟何在，我们会发现它归结为两个主要目标：自由与平等。

rows.original: If we ask in what precisely consists the greatest good of all, which should be the end of every system of legislation, we shall find it reduce itself to two main objects, liberty and equality

rows: 没有公民富到可以买下他人，也没有人穷到被迫出卖自己。

rows.original: no citizen shall ever be wealthy enough to buy another, and none poor enough to be forced to sell himself

rows: 由此可见，国家愈大，自由愈少。

rows.original: From this it follows that, the larger the State, the less the liberty.

rows: 一旦公务不再是公民的主要事务，他们宁愿出钱而不愿亲身效力，国家便离倾覆不远了。

rows.original: As soon as public service ceases to be the chief business of the citizens, and they would rather serve with their money than with their persons, the State is not far from its fall.

rows: 英国人民自以为自由，其实大错；他们只在选举议员期间是自由的。

rows.original: The people of England regards itself as free; but it is grossly mistaken; it is free only during the election of members of parliament.

rows: 和平、团结与平等，是政治权术的敌人。

rows.original: Peace, unity and equality are the enemies of political subtleties.

rows: 我向你们发誓，先生们，意识过剩是一种病——一种彻彻底底的病。

rows.original: I swear, gentlemen, that to be too conscious is an illness—a real thorough-going illness.

rows: 然而人是轻浮而乖谬的生物，也许就像棋手，爱的是博弈的过程，而不是结局。

rows.original: But man is a frivolous and incongruous creature, and perhaps, like a chess player, loves the process of the game, not the end of it.

rows: 人有时会异常热烈地爱上痛苦，这是事实。

rows.original: Man is sometimes extraordinarily, passionately, in love with suffering, and that is a fact.

rows: 可我仍认为，人绝不会放弃真正的痛苦，也就是破坏与混乱。因为痛苦正是意识的唯一源头。

rows.original: And yet I think man will never renounce real suffering, that is, destruction and chaos. Why, suffering is the sole origin of consciousness.

rows: 我信这个，我为此担保：人的全部作为，似乎只在于每分钟向自己证明，他是人，不是琴键。

rows.original: I believe in it, I answer for it, for the whole work of man really seems to consist in nothing but proving to himself every minute that he is a man and not a piano-key!

rows: 可人这样偏爱体系与抽象推理，以至于情愿故意歪曲真相，情愿否认感官的明证，只为让逻辑成立。

rows.original: But man has such a predilection for systems and abstract deductions that he is ready to distort the truth intentionally, he is ready to deny the evidence of his senses only to justify his logic.

rows: 我若真没有撞倒石墙的力气，就无法用头把它撞穿；但我不肯仅仅因为它是石墙、我没有力气，就同它和解。

rows.original: I cannot break through the wall by battering my head against it if I really have not the strength to knock it down, but I am not going to be reconciled to it simply because it is a stone wall and I have not the strength.

rows: 如今我在自己的角落里打发余生，用一句恶毒而无用的安慰嘲弄自己：聪明人是做不成任何正经事的，能成事的只有蠢人。

rows.original: Now, I am living out my life in my corner, taunting myself with the spiteful and useless consolation that an intelligent man cannot become anything seriously, and it is only the fool who becomes anything.

rows: 可如果每个聪明人直接而唯一的使命就是空谈，也就是故意往筛子里倒水，那又该怎么办？

rows.original: But what is to be done if the direct and sole vocation of every intelligent man is babble, that is, the intentional pouring of water through a sieve?

rows: 我们的生活以这种形态出现时常常毫无价值，可它仍是生活，而不只是开平方根。

rows.original: And although our life, in this manifestation of it, is often worthless, yet it is life and not simply extracting square roots.

rows: 每个人都有一些回忆，不愿讲给所有人听，只讲给朋友。

rows.original: Every man has reminiscences which he would not tell to everyone, but only to his friends.

rows: 天哪，先生们，一旦落到列表与算术上，一旦一切不过是二二得四，还剩下什么自由意志？

rows.original: Good heavens, gentlemen, what sort of free will is left when we come to tabulation and arithmetic, when it will all be a case of twice two make four?

rows: 因为人存在的秘密，不只在于活着，更在于为什么而活。

rows.original: For the secret of man’s being is not only to live but to have something to live for.

rows: 可怕的是，美既神秘又可怖。上帝与魔鬼在那里交战，而战场就是人心。

rows.original: The awful thing is that beauty is mysterious as well as terrible. God and the devil are fighting there and the battlefield is the heart of man.

rows: 要爱一个人，即使在他有罪的时候，因为那是神的爱的影子，是世上最高的爱。

rows.original: Love a man even in his sin, for that is the semblance of Divine Love and is the highest love on earth.

rows: 爱上帝所创造的一切，爱整体，也爱其中每一粒沙。爱每一片叶子，爱上帝之光的每一道光芒。

rows.original: Love all God’s creation, the whole and every grain of sand in it. Love every leaf, every ray of God’s light.

rows: 对自己说谎、又听信自己谎言的人，会走到分不清心中与身外的真实的地步，于是失去对自己和对别人的一切敬意。

rows.original: The man who lies to himself and listens to his own lie comes to such a pass that he cannot distinguish the truth within him, or around him, and so loses all respect for himself and for others.

rows: 爱是这样一件无价的珍宝，可以用它赎回整个世界，不仅赎自己的罪，也赎别人的罪。

rows.original: Love is such a priceless treasure that you can redeem the whole world by it, and expiate not only your own sins but the sins of others.

rows: 但行动的爱是劳作与坚忍，对某些人来说，也许还是一门完整的学问。

rows.original: But active love is labor and fortitude, and for some people too, perhaps, a complete science.

rows: 我越爱一般的人类，就越不爱具体的人。

rows.original: The more I love humanity in general, the less I love man in particular.

rows: 人们常对你大谈教育，但童年留下的一点美好而神圣的回忆，也许才是最好的教育。

rows.original: People talk to you a great deal about your education, but some good, sacred memory, preserved from childhood, is perhaps the best education.

rows: 世界靠荒诞支撑，若没有荒诞，世上也许什么事都成不了。

rows.original: The world stands on absurdities, and perhaps nothing would have come to pass in it without them.

rows: 在农民中间能遇到一种沉默而久忍的悲伤。它退回自身，一言不发。

rows.original: There is silent and long-suffering sorrow to be met with among the peasantry. It withdraws into itself and is still.

rows: 我想，如果魔鬼并不存在，是人创造了他，那也是照着自己的形象造的。

rows.original: I think if the devil doesn’t exist, but man has created him, he has created him in his own image and likeness.

rows: 幸福的家庭都是相似的，不幸的家庭各有各的不幸。

rows.original: Happy families are all alike; every unhappy family is unhappy in its own way.

rows: 生活的一切变化、一切魅力、一切美，都是由光与影组成的。

rows.original: All the variety, all the charm, all the beauty of life is made up of light and shadow.

rows: 没有别的解答，只有生活给予一切问题的那种通用解答，哪怕问题最复杂、最无解。那答案就是：活在当日的需要里，也就是忘掉自己。

rows.original: There was no solution, but that universal solution which life gives to all questions, even the most complex and insoluble. That answer is: one must live in the needs of the day—that is, forget oneself.

rows: 没有哪一种处境是人不能习惯的，尤其是当他看到周围的人都这样活着。

rows.original: There are no conditions to which a man cannot become used, especially if he sees that all around him are living in the same way.

rows: 无论哪一方面的虚伪，都能骗过最聪明、最敏锐的人，可最不警醒的孩子也能识破它，并对它生出反感，不管它伪装得多巧妙。

rows.original: Hypocrisy in anything whatever may deceive the cleverest and most penetrating man, but the least wide-awake of children recognizes it, and is revolted by it, however ingeniously it may be disguised.

rows: 尊敬是为了遮盖本该有爱的地方而发明出来的。

rows.original: Respect was invented to cover the empty place where love should be.

rows: 那尚未解开的死亡之谜刚从眼前过去，另一个同样无解的谜又升起来，催他去爱，去活。

rows.original: The one mystery of death, still unsolved, had scarcely passed before his eyes, when another mystery had arisen, as insoluble, urging him to love and to life.

rows: 怎样生活的问题才刚在他心里稍微清楚一点，一个新的、无解的问题就出现了——死。

rows.original: The question how to live had hardly begun to grow a little clearer to him, when a new, insoluble question presented itself—death.

rows: 只要不去惯坏孩子，不去扭曲他们的天性，他们就会十分可爱。

rows.original: All one has to do is not spoil children, not to distort their nature, and they’ll be delightful.

rows: 家庭生活中要办成任何一件事，夫妻之间必须有彻底的分工，或者有充满爱的默契。

rows.original: In order to carry through any undertaking in family life, there must necessarily be either complete division between the husband and wife, or loving agreement.

rows: 我们被抛到这世上，难道只是为了彼此憎恨，从而折磨自己，也折磨对方？

rows.original: Aren’t we all flung into the world only to hate each other, and so to torture ourselves and each other?

rows: 答案是我的生活本身给我的，就在我懂得何为对、何为错之中。

rows.original: The answer has been given me by life itself, in my knowledge of what is right and what is wrong.

rows: 哪里没有淳朴、善良与真实，哪里就没有伟大。

rows.original: And there is no greatness where simplicity, goodness, and truth are absent.

rows: 如果有上帝，有来世，那就有真理与善，而人的最高幸福，就在于努力去达到它们。

rows.original: If there is a God and future life, there is truth and good, and man’s highest happiness consists in striving to attain them.

rows: 人在动身远行或改变生活方式的时候，若能思索，心头多半是严肃的。

rows.original: When starting on a journey or changing their mode of life, men capable of reflection are generally in a serious frame of mind.

rows: 即使最要好、最单纯的关系里，称赞也是不可少的，就像车轮需要润滑油才能转得顺。

rows.original: Even in the best, most friendly and simplest relations of life, praise and commendation are essential, just as grease is necessary to wheels that they may run smoothly.

rows: 生命就是一切。生命就是上帝。万物都在变化、在运动，这运动就是上帝。

rows.original: Life is everything. Life is God. Everything changes and moves and that movement is God.

rows: 在历史事件里，所谓伟人只是给事件命名的标签；而作为标签，他们与事件本身的关系微乎其微。

rows.original: In historic events the so-called great men are labels giving names to events, and like labels they have but the smallest connection with the event itself.

rows: 抓住幸福的时刻，去爱，也被爱！这是世上唯一的真实，其余都是虚妄。

rows.original: Seize the moments of happiness, love and be loved! That is the only reality in the world, all else is folly.

rows: 爱阻挡死亡。爱就是生命。我所理解的一切，全部，都只因为我爱才得以理解。

rows.original: Love hinders death. Love is life. All, everything that I understand, I understand only because I love.

rows: 战争不是客套，而是生活里最可怕的事；我们应当明白这一点，不要拿战争当游戏。

rows.original: War is not courtesy but the most horrible thing in life; and we ought to understand that and not play at war.

rows: 最高的智慧只有一门学问——关于整体的学问，解释整个创造以及人在其中位置的学问。

rows.original: The highest wisdom has but one science—the science of the whole—the science explaining the whole creation and man’s place in it.

rows: 我们以为一旦被抛出旧辙就一切都完了，可正是在那时，新的、好的东西才开始。

rows.original: We imagine that when we are thrown out of our usual ruts all is lost, but it is only then that what is new and good begins.

rows: 我们越想合理地解释历史上的这类事件，它们对我们就越显得不合理、不可理解。

rows.original: The more we try to explain such events in history reasonably, the more unreasonable and incomprehensible do they become to us.

小蟾斜影转东篱，夜冷残蛩语。

黄蜂频扑秋千索，有当时、纤手香凝。

荷笠带斜阳，青山独归远。
古调虽自爱，今人多不弹。
寒雨连江夜入吴，平明送客楚山孤。
平阳歌舞新承宠，帘外春寒赐锦袍。
遥知兄弟登高处，遍插茱萸少一人。
醉卧沙场君莫笑，古来征战几人回？
泪湿罗巾梦不成，夜深前殿按歌声。
含情欲说宫中事，鹦鹉前头不敢言。
妆罢低声问夫婿，画眉深浅入时无。
故园东望路漫漫，双袖龙钟泪不干。
孤帆远影碧空尽，唯见长江天际流。
回乐烽前沙似雪，受降城外月如霜。
可怜夜半虚前席，不问苍生问鬼神。
春风举国裁宫锦，半作障泥半作帆。
八骏日行三万里，穆王何事不重来。
嫦娥应悔偷灵药，碧海青天夜夜心。
多情却似总无情，唯觉樽前笑不成。
青山隐隐水迢迢，秋尽江南草未凋。
天阶夜色凉如水，卧看牵牛织女星。
折戟沉沙铁未销，自将磨洗认前朝。
商女不知亡国恨，隔江犹唱后庭花。
三春白雪归青冢，万里黄河绕黑山。
谁谓伤心画不成，画人心逐世人情。
独怜幽草涧边生，上有黄鹂深树鸣。
隐隐飞桥隔野烟，石矶西畔问渔船。
潮落夜江斜月里，两三星火是瓜州。
斜拔玉钗灯影畔，剔开红焰救飞蛾。
却嫌脂粉污颜色，淡扫蛾眉朝至尊。
月落乌啼霜满天，江枫渔火对愁眠。
儿童相见不相识，笑问客从何处来。
雁声远过潇湘去，十二楼中月自明。
更深月色半人家，北斗阑干南斗斜。
寂寞空庭春欲晚，梨花满地不开门。
朱雀桥边野草花，乌衣巷口夕阳斜。
行到中庭数花朵，蜻蜓飞上玉搔头。
春城无处不飞花，寒食东风御柳斜。
君门一入无由出，唯有宫莺得见人。
山中一夜雨，树杪百重泉。
郡邑浮前浦，波澜动远空。
白云回望合，青霭入看无。
松风吹解带，山月照弹琴。
泉声咽危石，日色冷青松。
渡头余落日，墟里上孤烟。
空山新雨后，天气晚来秋。
荒城临古渡，落日满秋山。
孤灯寒照雨，深竹暗浮烟。
他乡生白发，旧国见青山。
远芳侵古道，晴翠接荒城。
白发悲花落，青云羡鸟飞。
为我一挥手，如听万壑松。
红颜弃轩冕，白首卧松云。
山随平野尽，江入大荒流。
挥手自兹去，萧萧班马鸣。
问姓惊初见，称名忆旧容。
五更疏欲断，一树碧无情。
芳心向春尽，所得是沾衣。
吴楚东南坼，乾坤日夜浮。
近泪无干土，低空有断云。
飘飘何所似，天地一沙鸥。
戍鼓断人行，边秋一雁声。
文章憎命达，魑魅喜人过。
香雾云鬟湿，清辉玉臂寒。
感时花溅泪，恨别鸟惊心。
星临万户动，月傍九霄多。
云霞出海曙，梅柳渡江春。
谁能将旗鼓，一为取龙城。
风鸣两岸叶，月照一孤舟。
当路谁相假，知音世所稀。
乡泪客中尽，孤帆天际看。
绿树村边合，青山郭外斜。
江山留胜迹，我辈复登临。
漠漠帆来重，冥冥鸟去迟。
落叶他乡树，寒灯独夜人。
猿啼洞庭树，人在木兰舟。
渐与骨肉远，转于僮仆亲。
暮雨相呼失，寒塘欲下迟。
山光悦鸟性，潭影空人心。
灭烛怜光满，披衣觉露滋。
欲祭疑君在，天涯哭此时。
帝乡明日到，犹自梦渔樵。
溪花与禅意，相对亦忘言。
老至居人下，春归在客先。
夕阳依旧垒，寒磬满空林。
飞鸟没何处，青山空向人。
天地英雄气，千秋尚凛然。
时有落花至，远随流水香。
少孤为客早，多难识君迟。
惟怜一灯影，万里眼中明。
竹怜新雨后，山爱夕阳时。
露重飞难进，风多响易沉。
还作江南会，翻疑梦里逢。
星河秋一雁，砧杵夜千家。
不。他们有权无知。知情只意味着共谋其罪；无知自有一种尊严。

rows.original: No. They have a right to be ignorant. Knowledge only means complicity in guilt; ignorance has a certain dignity.

rows: “正在考虑”的意思是“我们把文件弄丢了”；“正在积极考虑”的意思是“我们正在找”。

rows.original: Well, "under consideration" means "we've lost the file"; "under active consideration" means "we're trying to find it".

rows: 伯纳德，这届政府是来治理的，不只是像前任那样坐镇而已。国家顺着坡往下滑时，总得有人坐进驾驶座，把脚踩上油门。

rows.original: Bernard, this government is here to govern, not merely preside like our predecessors did. When a country is going downhill, it is time for someone to get into the driving seat, and put his foot on the accelerator.

rows: 大臣，我可不会把文官系统的拖延称作“战术”，那等于把惰性误当成战略。

rows.original: Well, I wouldn't call Civil Service delays "tactics", Minister, that would be to mistake lethargy for strategy.

rows: 我们当然永远支持您，大臣；不过是为您执旗，不是为您扶灵。

rows.original: Oh, we'll always support you, Minister; but as your standard bearer, not as your pallbearer.

rows: 哦，对！“有争议”只意味着“这会让你丢选票”；“有勇气”意味着“这会让你输掉大选”。

rows.original: Oh, yes! "Controversial" only means "this will lose you votes". "Courageous" means "this will lose you the election"!

rows: 伯纳德，大臣永远不该知道超出他必须知道的。这样他们就没法告诉任何人。就像特工，万一被俘、遭到拷问呢。

rows.original: Bernard, Ministers should never know more than they need to know. Then they can't tell anyone. Like secret agents; they could be captured and tortured.

rows: 你是说，这次做对了，下次就还得做对？那什么事都别想办成了！

rows.original: You mean that if we do the right thing this time, we might have to do the right thing again next time? Nothing would ever get done at all!

rows: 你没有被解职的危险。在企业里，你把事情搞砸，走人的是你；在文官系统里，你把事情搞砸，走人的是我。

rows.original: You're in no danger of the sack. In industry if you screw things up, you get the boot. In the civil service, if you screw things up, I get the boot.

rows: 这是人民的意志。我是他们的领袖，我必须跟随他们。

rows.original: It's the people's will. I am their leader; I must follow them.

rows: 文官信仰的三条教义：要把事办快，就得花更长时间；要把事办得便宜，就得更费钱；要把事办得保密，就得更民主。

rows.original: The three articles of Civil Service faith: it takes longer to do things quickly, it's more expensive to do them cheaply and it's more democratic to do them in secret.

rows: 大臣，如果您仅仅因为她们最适合这份工作就提拔女性，整个文官系统都会因此怨气冲天！

rows.original: Now, Minister, if you are going to promote women just because they're the best person for the job, you will create a lot of resentment throughout the whole of the Civil Service!

rows: 让大臣们以为自己办成了点什么，日子就好过得多；他们不再焦躁，也不再发小孩子脾气。

rows.original: Life is so much easier when ministers think they've achieved something; it stops them fretting, and their little temper tantrums.

rows: 不，不，大臣！那绝不可能是政府政策。这不可想象！那只是政府惯例。

rows.original: No, no, Minister! It could never be government policy. That is unthinkable! Only government practice.

rows: 嗯，几乎所有的政府政策都是错的，只不过……执行得极其出色。

rows.original: Well, almost all government policy is wrong, but… frightfully well carried out.

rows: 开放政府，首相。信息自由。凡是报界轻易就能从别处打听到的，我们都该自由而坦率地告诉他们。

rows.original: Open government, Prime Minister. Freedom of information. We should always tell the press freely and frankly anything that they could easily find out some other way.

rows: 这很明显，伯纳德。外交部会欣然给他三个选项，其中两个仔细一看完全相同。

rows.original: Well, it's obvious, Bernard. The Foreign Office will happily present him with three options, two of which are, on close inspection, exactly the same.

rows: 主教们往往长寿。看来上帝并不太急着让他们来见自己。

rows.original: Bishops tend to have long lives. Apparently the Lord isn't all that keen to let them join him.

rows: 一旦他们接受“高级文官可以因无能而被免职”这条原则，那就是楔子的薄端。我们会失去几十个同僚，也许几百个。

rows.original: If once they accepted the principle that senior Civil Servants could be removed for incompetence, that would be the thin end of the wedge. We could lose dozens of our chaps. Hundreds, perhaps.

rows: 感激，不过是对日后好处的热切期待。

rows.original: Gratitude is merely a lively expectation of favours to come.

rows: 会议记录不是为了记下事情，而是为了保护人。如果首相说了他本不想说的话，尤其当这话与他公开的表态相矛盾时，你就别做笔记。

rows.original: The purpose of minutes is not to record events, it is to protect people. You do not take notes if the Prime Minister says something he did not mean to say, particularly if it contradicts something he has said publicly.

rows: 要理解报界，只需记住一点：他们迎合读者的偏见。

rows.original: The only way to understand the Press is to remember that they pander to their readers' prejudices.

rows: 我倒觉得，四分之三的时间都无聊透顶，正是为工作生涯做的极好准备。

rows.original: Well, I should have thought that being bored stiff for three-quarters of the time was an excellent preparation for working life.

rows: 有责无权：古往今来宦官的专属特权。

rows.original: Responsibility without power: the prerogative of the eunuch throughout the ages.

rows: 不，首相，澄清不是为了把话说清楚，而是为了把自己摘清楚。

rows.original: No, Prime Minister, a clarification is not to make oneself clear, it is to put oneself IN the clear.

rows: 琳达，承诺的本质，就是对变化的情势免疫。

rows.original: The nature of promises, Linda, is that they remain immune to changing circumstances.

rows: 懦夫的脸是什么样？是他逃过战场时留给你的后脑勺。

rows.original: What is the face of a coward? The back of his head as he runs through the battle.

rows: 你看，弗雷迪觉得，要是冰箱从面包车上掉下来，你最好赶紧躲开。我却觉得，该躲开的是那台冰箱。

rows.original: You see, Freddy believes that if a fridge falls off a minivan, you better swerve out of its way. I believe it's the fridge's job to swerve out of mine.

rows: 要压住一丝疑虑，没有比放出一股赤裸真相更好的办法。

rows.original: There's no better way to overpower a trickle of doubt than with a flood of naked truth.

rows: 离权力太近，会让一些人误以为自己握着权力。

rows.original: Proximity to power deludes some into believing they wield it.

rows: 我敬重的事情有很多，规则不在其中。

rows.original: Of all the things I hold in high regards, rules are not one of them.

rows: 离总统之位只差一次心跳，却没有一票是投给我的。民主真是被高估了。

rows.original: One heartbeat away from the presidency and not a vote cast in my name. Democracy is so overrated.

rows: 要是从不做不该做的事，做该做的事时也就不会那么痛快。

rows.original: If we never did anything we shouldn't do, we'd never feel good about doing the things we should.

rows: 念念不忘历史的总统，惦记的是自己在其中的位置，而不是去缔造历史。

rows.original: Presidents who obsess over history obsess over their place in it, instead of forging it.

rows: 你觉得我是伪君子？你该这么觉得。我不会反驳。通往权力的路是用伪善和牺牲铺成的。永不后悔。

rows.original: Do you think I’m a hypocrite? Well you should. I wouldn’t disagree with you. The road to power is paved with hypocrisy, and casualties. Never regret.

rows: 我一向厌恶睡眠这种必需。它像死亡，把最强的人也要放倒。

rows.original: I've always loathed the necessity of sleep. Like death, it puts even the most powerful of men on their backs.

rows: 出了狮笼，又进了狼群。你是鲜肉的时候，就得动手杀，再扔点更新鲜的给他们。

rows.original: From the lion's den to a pack of wolves. When you're fresh meat, kill and throw them something fresher.

rows: 从“不”到“是”，中间少不了一个“也许”。

rows.original: You can't turn a no to a yes without a maybe in between.

rows: 没有哪个像样的作家能抗拒一个好故事，正如没有哪个政客能抗拒许下兑现不了的承诺。

rows.original: No writer worth his salt can resist a good story, just as no politician can resist making promises he can't keep.

rows: 有时我觉得，总统之位不过是一种选择的幻觉。

rows.original: Sometimes I think the presidency is the illusion of choice.
